title: Traffic lights and staying safe
examples: Teacher, when is it okay to cross the road?
What does the yellow light mean for cars?
Can we cross when the light is red?

explain.say: Look at the traffic light. It has three colours.
When the light is red, it means stop right away.

items: Wait for the light to change

explain.say: The amber light means get ready to stop soon.
When you see the green walking person, you can cross safely.
If the lights are red, we must wait until they turn green.
When we cross the road, we must always look both ways first.

faq.q: What does the red light mean?
faq.a: The red light means everyone must stop and wait for the signal to change.
asks: Can we cross when it is red?
What do we do at a red light?

faq.q: What is the amber light for?
faq.a: The amber light tells us that the light is about to change soon.

faq.q: When can we cross the street?
faq.a: We can only cross when the green walking person light is on.
asks: What does the green man mean?
Is it always safe to cross?

faq.q: Do we always look both ways?
faq.a: Yes, even when the light is green, we must look left and right.

faq.q: What if the light is broken?
faq.a: If the light is broken, we must always listen carefully to the police officer.
asks: Who do we listen to if the light is out?
What if the traffic light is not working?

facts: Red lights mean stop for everyone.
Amber lights mean be ready to stop.
Green walking people mean it is safe to cross.
We must always look left and right before crossing.

quiz.say: If the traffic light is red, what should you do?
quiz.why: Red means stop, so you must wait for the light to change.

wrong.0: This is wrong because red means you must stop completely.
wrong.1: This is wrong because running is dangerous when the light is red.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you must wait for the signal, not just a car.

quiz.say: The amber light tells you to:

options.show: Go as fast as you can
options.say: Go as fast as you can

quiz.why: Amber means the light is changing, so you need to slow down.

wrong.0: This is wrong because you only stop if it is red.
wrong.1: This is wrong because you must slow down when the light changes.
wrong.2: This is wrong because amber means action is needed now.

quiz.say: When crossing, you must look left, then:

options.show: Look where you want to go
options.say: Look where you want to go

quiz.why: After looking left, you must always look right to be safe.

wrong.0: This is wrong because you must focus on the traffic around you.
wrong.1: This is wrong because you must check all directions first.
wrong.3: This is wrong because you need to look at the road, not the sky.
